translations.web: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
translations.bsb: Do you listen in on the council of God or limit wisdom to yourself?
translations.kjv: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom
translations.asv: Hast thou heard the secret counsel of God? And dost thou limit wisdom to thyself?
